Two-action minimization update reduces the probability of the worse finite-horizon action.
Startup rejects missing tail/gate, old namespace, wrong version/contract and unapproved training.
32 legacy regression suites pass; protected resources/results unchanged.
The production learning-stability guard passes good synthetic stores, holds a regressed seed and rejects altered raw evidence.
limits: Negative target on an individual failed stochastic trajectory is not by itself a bug.
